title.en: JD Vance says wife Usha and son 'happy and healthy' after birth of fourth child
title.zh: JD·万斯称妻子乌莎和儿子在第四个孩子出生后“幸福健康”

summary.en: The couple welcomed their fourth child, Alec Neel Vance, on Sunday morning.
summary.zh: 这对夫妇于周日早上迎来了他们的第四个孩子，取名为亚历克·尼尔·万斯。

body.en:
US Vice-President JD Vance has announced the birth of his fourth child, a boy, with his wife Usha Vance.

Alec Neel Vance was born on Sunday morning, the vice-president said in a statement on social media.

“Usha and the baby are happy and healthy, and our kids are overjoyed to meet their little brother,” he added, also thanking the military doctors and staff at Walter Reed Medical Center for their care.

It is the first time a baby has been born to a sitting vice-president while in office for more than 150 years, according to the Associated Press. President Donald Trump hailed the news, writing in a post: "Congratulations! A perfect baby boy for the wonderful Vance family."

The pair have three other children: Ewan, 9, Vivek, 6, and four-year-old Mirabel.

Usha Vance (née Chilukuri) was born and raised in the working-class suburbs of San Diego, California, to a mechanical engineer father and a molecular biologist mother who had moved to the US from Andhra Pradesh, India.

She met JD Vance as a student at Yale Law School in 2010, when they joined a discussion group on "social decline in white America".

JD Vance has been one of the most vocal members of the Trump administration in calling for higher birth rates in the US.

He wrote in his recently published book that Usha had initially been reluctant to have another child but that her mind changed after conservative influencer Charlie Kirk was killed last year.

"Not long after we buried my friend, she became pregnant with our fourth child, a boy," he wrote. "One life was stolen from us, but another was given."
body.zh: 美国副总统万斯 (JD Vance) 宣布与妻子乌莎·万斯 (Usha Vance) 生下第四个孩子，一名男孩。 副总统在社交媒体上的一份声明中表示，亚历克·尼尔·万斯于周日早上出生。 他补充道：“乌莎和婴儿都很快乐、健康，我们的孩子们很高兴见到他们的弟弟。”他还感谢军医和沃尔特·里德医疗中心工作人员的照顾。 据美联社报道，这是 150 多年来现任副总统在任期间第一次生下孩子。唐纳德·特朗普总统对这一消息表示欢迎，并在帖子中写道：“恭喜！为美好的万斯家庭带来了一个完美的男婴。” 这对夫妇还有另外三个孩子：9 岁的 Ewan、6 岁的 Vivek 和 4 岁的 Mirabel。 乌莎·万斯（娘家姓奇卢库里）出生并成长于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥的工人阶级郊区，父亲是机械工程师，母亲是分子生物学家，从印度安得拉邦移居美国。 2010 年，她在耶鲁大学法学院就读时认识了 JD 万斯，当时他们加入了一个关于“美国白人社会衰退”的讨论小组。 JD万斯一直是特朗普政府中呼吁提高美国出生率最直言不讳的成员之一。 他在最近出版的书中写道，乌莎最初不愿意再生一个孩子，但去年保守派影响者查理·柯克被杀后，她的想法发生了变化。 “我们埋葬我的朋友后不久，她就怀上了我们的第四个孩子，一个男孩，”他写道。 “我们的一个生命被偷走了，但另一个生命却被给予了。”

reflection.en: The arrival of a new child is often a moment of profound joy and gratitude for families. This news reminds us of the timeless truth that children are a precious gift, bringing unique blessings and new life into the world. Yahweh's word affirms the deep value and heritage found in each new generation.
reflection.zh: 新生儿的到来常常是家庭深感喜悦和感恩的时刻。这则新闻提醒我们一个永恒的真理：孩子是宝贵的礼物，为世界带来独特的祝福和新的生命。雅伟的话语肯定了每一代新生命所蕴含的深远价值和传承。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Andy Burnham arrives at Buckingham Palace to become prime minister after Keir Starmer formally resigns – UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为新首相，并在唐宁街10号发表演讲，阐述英国“十年计划”——英国政治直播

summary.en: Andy Burnham is set to become the new Prime Minister of the UK and will deliver a speech from No 10 Downing Street, outlining a 10-year plan for the country. This follows Keir Starmer's final speech from the same location.
summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆将成为英国新首相，并将在唐宁街10号发表讲话，阐述英国的十年计划。此前，基尔·斯塔默已在同一地点发表了告别演说。

body.en: His Majesty received in audience the Rt Hon Andrew Burnham MP and requested him to form a new Administration. The Rt Hon Andrew Burnham MP accepted The King’s offer and kissed hands upon his appointment as Prime Minister and First Lord of the Treasury.
body.zh: 早上好。今天我们迎来了一位新总理。这是十多年来第六次发生这种情况（特蕾莎·梅于 2016 年 7 月 13 日接替大卫·卡梅伦），因此从某些方面来看，这并没有什么新奇或令人惊讶的地方。然而这个过程却很不寻常。过去，当执政党更换首相时，通常会选择受本党议员欢迎但在广大公众中不如其前任受欢迎的人（利兹·特拉斯、特蕾莎·梅、戈登·布朗），或者更受公众欢迎但不太受本党活动人士喜欢的人（约翰·梅杰、里希·苏纳克）。今年年初，任何关注民意调查的人都会得出结论，工党的合理选择是用安迪·伯纳姆取代凯尔·斯塔默。工党并不总是因做出有利于选举的决定而闻名，但在这种情况下，这就是它所取得的成就。它取代了一位成为选举重担的总理，取而代之的是该国最受尊敬的政治家之一——至少目前如此——整个政党都支持他。 在伯纳姆任命内阁后，情况可能最终不会发生。我们得看看。以下是罗威娜·梅森 (Rowena Mason) 昨晚讲述的关于今天会发生什么的故事。 伯纳姆接受了《泰晤士报》的采访，虽然其中没有任何重大的新公告，但其中充满了关于他将如何执政的有趣线索。有两个特别突出。 首先，伯纳姆表示他将为该国制定一个“十年计划”。他还告诉《泰晤士报》，这是关于他的野心规模的声明，而不是关于他计划担任总理多久。采访伯纳姆的帕特里克·马奎尔说道： 本周[伯纳姆]将告诉我们他的“国家十年计划”。他承认，也许他的首相任期不会持续那么久。 “我并不是说这意味着我要在这里待十年……更多的是我们在结构上没有处于正确的位置，我们作为一个国家没有处于正确的位置。我认为人们可以感觉到这一点。” 其次，伯纳姆驳斥了有关他本质上是税收筹集者的说法。他甚至建议，他想扭转个人免税额的冻结，这种冻结起到了隐形税的作用，导致人们每年随着工资上涨而缴纳的税款成比例增加，但免税额却没有增加。伯纳姆告诉马奎尔： 我在梅克菲尔德家门口听到最多的一件事是对冻结在 12,570 英镑的个人津贴感到沮丧……[那个抱怨]留在了我的脑海里。 伯纳姆没有承诺结束冻结，这将花费数十亿美元。但他表示自己并不是下意识的增税者。他告诉马奎尔： 他们只是把我描述为一个征税者。好吧，再说一遍，事情从来没有那么简单，不是吗？ 最后的...

reflection.en: As a new Prime Minister steps into office with a long-term plan, the wisdom of Proverbs reminds us that a clear vision is essential for a nation's flourishing. Without purposeful guidance, societies can drift; with it, there is hope for stability and progress. May Yahweh grant leaders insight to chart a course that serves the common good.
reflection.zh: 随着新首相上任并提出十年计划，箴言的智慧提醒我们，清晰的愿景对国家的繁荣至关重要。没有有目的的指引，社会可能迷失方向；有了它，就有稳定和进步的希望。愿雅伟赐予领导者洞察力，为共同利益规划路线。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: Trump says US strikes hit Iran in 'honour' of American soldiers killed
title.zh: 特朗普称美国空袭伊朗是为了“纪念”阵亡美国士兵

summary.en: Iran responded with attacks in Syria and Jordan, as two ships reportedly exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
President Donald Trump says the latest strikes by the US hit Iran "very hard", adding that the attacks were "in honour" of three US soldiers killed in recent days - two in Jordan, one in Iraq.

In the early hours of Monday local time, US Central Command (Centcom) said it had launched a "new wave" of strikes for the ninth consecutive night as explosions were heard across Iran.

The US said it had targeted military sites and communications networks to "further diminish" Tehran's attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran said it had responded with a "surprise attack" in Syria and targeted US aircraft at Jordan's Aqaba airport.

Elsewhere in the region, Kuwait's armed forces said they had intercepted Iranian drones.

On the US strikes, Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency reported that several cities had been hit including Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, Bandar Mahshahr and Bandar Imam Khomeini.

There were also Iranian state media reports that two oil tankers had exploded as the vessels tried to cross the strait.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said the tankers were going through what it called an "unsafe and hazardous southern route" of the strait and "exploded and were brought to a halt". Centcom disputed the claims.

The IRGC added that the strait "will not be safe for the transit of petrochemical products, nor even a single drop of oil and gas" as long as the US strikes continue and that it will respond with a "punitive operation".

Over the weekend, the US confirmed that a service member had been killed after an Iranian attack in northern Iraq on Saturday.

That news came after the US said a separate attack on a base in Jordan on Friday had killed two soldiers there. The two have now been identified by the Pentagon as Pte Isabella Gonzales, 19, and Lt Tyler James Feehan, 25.

A third serviceperson was declared missing after the attack in Jordan, and US officials say "unidentified remains" have been found during the search process.

As the strikes continued over the weekend between the US and Iran, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the US "always remains open to a diplomatic solution".

He also said "the world has to decide whether or not it's going to allow an international waterway to be under the control" of Iran, saying Tehran was using the crucial shipping route as leverage.

His comments come as a preliminary deal made in mid-June to stop fighting has unravelled, with negotiations for a permanent peace making little progress after Trump declared the agreement was "over" on 8 July.
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，美国最近的袭击对伊朗造成了“非常沉重的打击”，并补充说，这些袭击是为了“纪念”最近几天阵亡的三名美国士兵，其中两人在约旦，一人在伊拉克。 当地时间周一凌晨，美国中央司令部（Centcom）表示，伊朗各地传出爆炸声，已连续第九晚发动“新一波”打击。 美国表示，它已将军事地点和通信网络作为目标，以“进一步减少”德黑兰对霍尔木兹海峡船只的袭击。 伊朗表示，它在叙利亚发动了“突然袭击”，并针对约旦亚喀巴机场的美国飞机进行了回应。 在该地区其他地方，科威特武装部队表示他们拦截了伊朗无人机。 关于美国的空袭，伊朗半官方通讯社塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，包括大不里士、恰巴哈尔、科纳拉克、马赫沙赫尔港和伊玛目霍梅尼港在内的多个城市遭到袭击。 伊朗官方媒体也报道称，两艘油轮在试图穿越海峡时发生爆炸。 伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）表示，这些油轮当时正在通过所谓的海峡“不安全且危险的南部路线”，并“爆炸并被迫停下来”。中央司令部对这些说法提出异议。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队补充说，只要美国继续发动袭击，该海峡“对于石化产品的过境来说就不安全，甚至一滴石油和天然气也不安全”，并表示将采取“惩罚性行动”予以回应。 周末，美国证实，周六伊朗在伊拉克​​北部发动袭击后，一名军人死亡。 这一消息是在美国表示周五对约旦一个基地的另一次袭击造成两名士兵死亡之后发布的。五角大楼现已确认这两人分别为 19 岁的伊莎贝拉·冈萨雷斯上尉和 25 岁的泰勒·詹姆斯·费汉中尉。 约旦袭击事件发生后，第三名军人被宣布失踪，美国官员表示，在搜索过程中发现了“身份不明的遗骸”。 随着周末美国和伊朗之间的袭击仍在继续，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，美国“始终对外交解决方案持开放态度”。 他还表示，“世界必须决定是否允许国际水道处于伊朗的控制之下”，并表示德黑兰正在利用这条重要的航线作为杠杆。 他发表此番言论之际，6月中旬达成的一项停止战斗的初步协议已经瓦解，特朗普于7月8日宣布该协议“结束”后，永久和平谈判几乎没有取得任何进展。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Israel's embassy takes rare swipe at Labor's platform on eve of conference
title.zh: 以色列大使馆在会议前夕罕见地抨击了工党的政纲

summary.en: The four-page statement drew a shrug from a member of Labor's front bench.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Israel's embassy has rebuked the Labor party's draft national platform, warning its wording on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict places sole "responsibility" on the Jewish state while overlooking the role of Hamas and Palestinian leadership.

The four-page statement is a highly unusual intervention by a foreign government ahead of the party's national conference in Adelaide.

Labor's 2026 platform, which outlines the party's priorities and beliefs, contains an expanded statement on "Israel and Palestine" following the government's move to recognise Palestinian statehood, a longstanding part of the party platform.

The document reiterates support for a two-state solution, and also says the party "unreservedly condemns terrorism and violent extremism, including as perpetrated by Hamas and other extremists," stating Israelis and Palestinians deserve to live their lives free from terror and violence.

The platform says Israel "must comply with obligations as an occupying power" in supplying food and medical supplies for Palestinian civilians under international humanitarian law, and also condemns recent Knesset laws around the death penalty as "discriminatory."

The 'Death Penalty for Terrorists' law passed in March — and a subsequent 2026 military tribunal law — mandate capital punishment for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The United Nations Human Rights Office warned the laws breach international humanitarian law and could amount to war crimes.

The unsigned Israeli embassy statement, released on Monday, reads: "The Embassy respectfully submits that several elements of the draft National Platform risk placing responsibility for the conflict on one party while giving insufficient attention to the decisions, conduct and continuing obligations of the Palestinian leadership and terrorist organisations such as Hamas."

"Israel has repeatedly demonstrated its willingness to make difficult compromises when genuine peace is possible."

While continuing to oppose Palestinian recognition, which the Australian government declared sovereign and independent in September 2025, Israel's embassy also disputed language in the draft platform condemning "extremist settler violence," which the government in June warned was at "horrific levels".

The embassy said settler violence "receives disproportionate attention," labelling it a "reprehensible but marginal phenomenon".

UN monitors have documented over 1,000 Israeli settler attacks causing casualties or property damage this year, averaging six incidents per day and resulting in the displacement of more than 2,200 Palestinians.

title.en: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
title.zh: 13岁男孩在西班牙世界杯庆祝活动中去世

summary.en: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A 13-year-old boy was killed after part of a fountain collapsed in Salamanca province, northwestern Spain, during the country's World Cup victory celebrations.

Two other young people were injured, emergency services told the BBC, including one child who was taken to hospital with a possible broken bone in his leg.

People were celebrating Spain's victory inside the Árbol Gordo fountain in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo, when it partially collapsed around 00:30 local time (23:30 BST).

"What was supposed to be a celebration for the victory in the Spanish National Football Team's World Cup has turned into a tragedy," Ciudad Rodrigo's town hall posted on social media.

Emergency services for Castilla y León said it had received several calls about the collapse of the fountain. Part of the structure gave way after several people climbed on it to celebrate Spain's win, local media reported.

The emergency service said it had notified the city's local police, as well as Salamanca's Civil Guard, its fire brigade and the local emergency medical service - which dispatched a mobile intensive care unit and a basic life support ambulance to the scene.

The emergency medical service later requested the presence of the Civil Guard at the local health centre to investigate the death of the boy who was treated there, the Castilla y León's regional government's website said.

It also requested the Civil Guard activate psychological support for the family.

The city's council said it "hopes for a speedy recovery of the others who have been affected by the incident".

Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in the World Cup final on Sunday after Ferran Torres scored in extra time.

It is the country's second ever World Cup win, after their last victory in 2010.

Earlier this month, three people died from suffocation during World Cup celebrations in Mexico City, while a 30-year-old man also died in an epileptic crisis.

title.zh: 从数百人到数千人：印度“蟑螂”抗议运动如何发展

summary.en: BBC's Azadeh Moshiri reports as thousands attempt to march to India's parliament in support of the Cockroach Janta Party's demand for education reforms.

body.en:
Thousands of people are attempting to march to India's parliament after the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) called a protest demanding reforms to the education system.

The group, which is not a real political party, started out as satire. But on Monday, it held its biggest protest yet.

BBC correspondent Azadeh Moshiri, who attended the group's first protest in early June, reports from the ground in Delhi.

title.en: Why are Ukraine's military recruiters facing violence in their own country?
title.zh: 为什么乌克兰的军事征兵人员在本国面临暴力？

summary.en: A report from the National Police Service in Ukraine has documented over 600 assaults on military recruitment officers, noting a concerning increase in the severity of these aggressive incidents.
summary.zh: 乌克兰国家警察局的最新报告记录了迄今为止超过600起针对军事征兵人员的袭击事件，并警告称这种侵略行为已变得“越来越具威胁性”。

body.en:
Ukraine is struggling to mobilise men to fight in the war against Russia as the conflict enters into its fifth year.

The reasons many people are hesitant to sign up range from plain fear of the front line to a reluctance to fight in a war with no end in sight.

This has led to some Ukrainians violently lashing out at recruitment officers trying to forcibly conscript them.

The latest National Police Service report recorded more than 600 assaults on recruitment officers to date and warned that the aggression has become "increasingly threatening".

In April, several recruiters were stabbed, one fatally. And in Lviv this month, some 200 protesters surrounded officers attempting to detain a suspected draft dodger and smashed and overturned their car.

The riot made headlines as President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned violence against serving soldiers.
body.zh: 随着冲突进入第五个年头，乌克兰正在努力动员人员参加对俄罗斯的战争。 许多人犹豫是否报名的原因包括对前线的恐惧，以及不愿参加一场看不到尽头的战争。 这导致一些乌克兰人猛烈抨击试图强行征召他们入伍的征兵官员。 国家警察局最新报告记录了迄今为止超过 600 起针对招募官员的袭击事件，并警告说，这种袭击行为已变得“越来越具有威胁性”。 4 月，几名招聘人员被刺伤，其中一人死亡。本月在利沃夫，约 200 名抗议者包围了试图拘留一名涉嫌逃兵的警察，并砸毁并掀翻了他们的汽车。 这场骚乱成为头条新闻，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基谴责针对现役士兵的暴力行为。

title.en: The Tate brothers' international legal saga: The cases, charges and what comes next
title.zh: 泰特兄弟的国际法律纠葛：案件、指控及后续发展

summary.en: Self-described misogynist Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan were arrested over the weekend in the US and face charges in multiple jurisdictions.
summary.zh: 自称厌女主义者的安德鲁·泰特及其兄弟特里斯坦周末在美国被捕，并面临多项司法管辖区的指控。

body.en:
On Sunday, social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami in the United States, after authorities in the United Kingdom issued 38 new charges against the brothers, deepening the pair's international legal saga and adding further complication to an already fraught legal situation.

The United Kingdom's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has charged the brothers — who deny all wrongdoing — with fresh counts of rape, actual bodily harm, and human trafficking.

The new accusations add to a mountain of serious charges against the pair and could lead to the brothers' extradition from the US, assuming it is approved by the US state department.

Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate are dual US-UK citizens who have risen to prominence as social media influencers.

Andrew started his career in public life as a kickboxer and has gone on to become a prominent figure in the online 'manosphere' space, describing himself as a misogynist and encouraging his more than 10 million followers to follow in his footsteps.

He primarily posts on X, having been banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram for violating hate speech guidelines.

Stephanie Wescott, a lecturer in humanities and social science at Monash University, described Andrew as the "main character" of this content, while his brother Tristan is more of a "side figure".

She said the Tates have turned disrespecting and abusing women into a business model that glamorises male dominance, 'teaching' men how to emulate them through an online academy.

"[They promote] anti-feminism, anti-gender-equality, and hyper-masculinity or, you know, 'men being men' or men going back to a type of manhood that no longer exists," she said.

"One of their business models has been to train other young men into becoming the sort of influencers that they claim that they are.

"Part of that business model has also been to exploit and harm the girls and women around you and to use their images as currency to sell online — we know Australian men have signed up for these services.

The pair have also expressed support for US President Donald Trump, and Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, spoke out against the brothers' detention in Romania in 2023.

"The other layer to this is, of course, that they have this incredible political proximity to Donald Trump," Wescott said.

In 2025, Andrew Tate said he was "very close with the Trump family". Trump himself has said little about the Tates, however.

"They have been supported and aided by adjacent figures, podcasters such as Joe Rogan and others like him," Wescott continued.

title.en: Nigel Farage's unusual UK by-election now has an Australian candidate
title.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇不寻常的英国补选现有一名澳大利亚候选人

summary.en: Nigel Farage will compete in the Clacton by-election against several candidates, including Count Binface and Australian Daniel Pocock.
summary.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇将在克拉克顿补选中与包括宾费斯伯爵和澳大利亚人丹尼尔·波科克在内的多位候选人竞争。

body.en:
There's a man with a bin on his head, three people representing the Monster Raving Loony Party, Nigel Farage and an Australian — now all vying for the seat vacated by the Reform UK leader in a crucial by-election.

The Clacton by-election, triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Farage over a donations scandal, has attracted all sorts of profiles to the mix.

Farage, who is under investigation over millions of pounds' worth of undeclared gifts and donations from wealthy backers, quit parliament earlier this month to trigger a by-election, but said he would re-contest his seat . The Reform UK leader said he wanted voters in his electoral district in south-east England to judge his actions, not what he said was a liberal "establishment" bent on discrediting him.

Farage is widely expected to win the seat again, and is the only mainstream candidate running, after other major parties said they would refuse to take part in what they characterised as a stunt.

A number of joke candidates — including Count Binface and another called 'Nick the Incredible Flying Brick' — are vying for the seat, along with 20 independents.

Pocock is a Swiss-Irish-Australian software engineer who describes himself as an "expert on cybersecurity, open source software [and] cryptocurrencies".

According to his website, he was born in the Melbourne suburb of Coburg before moving to rural Wandong. He graduated from the University of Melbourne in 2002 with a Bachelor of Computer Science.

While studying, he joined the National Union of Students and used his technical skills to assist websites for early social causes. He built a website opposing the death penalty after Schapelle Corby's arrest in Bali on drug trafficking charges.

He moved to Europe after graduation and worked for companies like Barclays Capital, Thomson Reuters, and UBS.

In a press release announcing his candidacy, Pocock says he was spurred to nominate himself for Clacton by the prospect of "novelty candidates".

"If the Essex Lion was to appear on the ballot paper, I suspect it would have an equally good chance of winning. I have yet to see a single report about the real, day-to-day issues facing residents of the district," he said.

"In a parody of this situation, I have chosen the codename Pocock-on-Sea for the operation to unleash an Australian upon London's Establishment."

Pocock said Farage has proposed many Australian policies to replace UK ones, though he did not specify which. Farage has previously outlined an immigration plan that echoes Australia's offshore processing system, which has been heavily criticised by human rights...
body.zh: 一名男子头上顶着一个垃圾箱，三名代表怪物狂欢党的人、奈杰尔·法拉奇和一名澳大利亚人——现在都在争夺英国改革派领导人在一次关键补选中空出的席位。 克拉克顿补选是由法拉奇因捐款丑闻在议会辞职而引发的，吸引了各种各样的人士参与其中。 法拉奇因来自富有支持者的价值数百万英镑的未申报礼物和捐赠而受到调查，他于本月早些时候退出议会以引发补选，但表示他将重新竞选席位。这位改革英国领导人表示，他希望英格兰东南部选区的选民来评判他的行为，而不是他所说的一心要抹黑他的自由派“建制派”。 人们普遍预计法拉奇将再次赢得席位，并且是唯一参加竞选的主流候选人，此前其他主要政党表示将拒绝参加他们所说的噱头。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 许多笑话候选人——包括宾菲斯伯爵和另一位被称为“不可思议的飞砖尼克”的候选人——正在与 20 名独立人士一起争夺这个席位。 Pocock 是一位瑞士、爱尔兰和澳大利亚混血的软件工程师，他将自己描述为“网络安全、开源软件[和]加密货币方面的专家”。 根据他的网站，他出生在墨尔本郊区的科堡，后来搬到万东农村。他于 2002 年毕业于墨尔本大学，获得计算机科学学士学位。 在学习期间，他加入了全国学生联合会，并利用自己的技术技能为早期社会事业的网站提供帮助。沙佩尔·科比因贩毒罪名在巴厘岛被捕后，他建立了一个反对死刑的网站。 毕业后，他移居欧洲，曾在巴克莱资本、汤森路透和瑞银等公司工作。 波科克在宣布参选的新闻稿中表示，由于“新奇候选人”的前景，他提名自己为克拉克顿议员。 “如果埃塞克斯雄狮出现在选票上，我怀疑它也有同样好的获胜机会。我还没有看到任何关于该地区居民面临的真实日常问题的报告，”他说。 “为了模仿这种情况，我选择了“Pocock-on-Sea”作为这次行动的代号，将一名澳大利亚人释放到伦敦的建制派上。” 波科克表示，法拉奇提出了许多澳大利亚政策来取代英国政策，但他没有具体说明是哪些政策。法拉奇此前概述了一项移民计划，该计划与澳大利亚的离岸处理系统相呼应，该系统受到了人权方面的严厉批评……

title.en: 'Impossible': Nauru community detainees say Australian funds not enough to buy food with
title.zh: “不可能”：瑙鲁社区被拘留者称澳大利亚资金不足以购买食物

summary.en: They face a choice between paying for food, water or internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Asylum seekers being detained within the community in Nauru are struggling to buy enough food and are being forced to choose between eating and paying for other necessities.

The difficulties are being driven by a mix of high living costs and low income support, according to a new report by the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre.

Of 78 people interviewed for the report, 99 per cent said they couldn't afford to buy enough food with their current allowance.

On top of that, 68 per cent said they rarely or never had access to fresh fruit, vegetables and meat, and 82 per cent said they didn't have easy access to free, clean drinking water.

Community detainees live on $260 a fortnight to cover all of their basic needs outside accommodation.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The group have been sent to the tiny island nation under Australia's long-standing policy of offshore processing for asylum-seekers who arrive by boat.

Speaking anonymously, detainees consistently told the centre the allowance wasn't enough to sustain them, forcing them to decide between buying food and other necessities like clothing and internet access.

Many were running out of money before their next payment and were forced to reduce meals or go without food altogether.

"With food we have to compromise, if you buy vegetables you can't afford rice. If you buy meat, you can't afford fruit," one said.

"The money is not enough because everything is expensive here — rice, fish, we cannot buy any fruit here, internet for $100 per month, how is it possible to survive?" said another.

Nauru struggles with food insecurity due to its remote location and limited local agriculture, with perishable food flown in weekly and often selling out quickly or being prohibitively expensive.

With no rivers or freshwater lakes, the island also relies primarily on rainwater harvesting and desalination, meaning water shortages are common during times of low rainfall, forcing those who live there to turn to bottled water.

Asylum seekers in the community often struggle due to their lack of orientation or local knowledge as to how food systems work, as well as infrequent transportation to and from markets, the resource centre said.

As of 31 May, there were 101 people seeking asylum in Nauru, 91 of whom were in community accommodation.

The majority of those in detention in Nauru were young to middle-aged men from south and east Asia.

The group of asylum seekers are separate from a group of hundreds of former immigration detainees, known as the NZYQ cohort, sent to Nauru from Australia after the High Court in 2024 ruled indefinite detention to be unlawful.

title.en: Algeria seeks larger EU energy role amid regional tensions
title.zh: 阿尔及利亚在地区紧张局势中寻求更大的欧盟能源角色

summary.en: Algeria and Germany have agreed to strengthen their energy partnership following President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's visit to Berlin. This agreement comes as Algeria continues to face internal challenges, including tensions related to Western Sahara and broader instability across the Sahel region.
summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩近期访问柏林后，阿尔及利亚与德国同意深化能源合作。然而，阿尔及利亚在国内仍面临紧张局势，包括西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定。

body.en:
Algeria and Germany agreed to deepen energy ties during President Abdelmadjid Tebboune's recent visit to Berlin. But Algiers is still grappling with tensions at home, over Western Sahara and instability in the Sahel.

For Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, this week's visit to Berlin marked his first official trip to Germany since he was elected president in 2019. The two-day visit was highlighted in a joint statement with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, in which the two leaders emphasized "the quality of cooperation" between their countries and pledged to deepen long-term energy cooperation.

" Algeria is a central partner for Europe's energy security. Natural gas supplies and cooperation on renewable energies are to be expanded. In the long term, it is about establishing a southern hydrogen corridor — from North Africa to Germany," Cerstin Gammelin, the spokesperson for German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier posted on X on Thursday.

Algeria is home to Africa's second-largest proven natural gas reserves after Nigeria . It is also Africa's largest natural gas producer. On July 2, Algeria's state-owned energy company Sonatrach delivered the first shipment of liquefied natural gas (LNG) directly to Germany's Wilhelmshaven 1 floating LNG import terminal. A direct pipeline to Germany would eliminate the need for liquefaction, LNG shipping and regasification for those volumes. This could reduce transport costs for gas deliveries, as is already the case with Algeria's two existing pipelines to Italy  and Spain .

"The war in Iran and the disruption of oil exports via the Strait of Hormuz have reinforced Algeria's energy importance," said Alice Gower, director of geopolitics and security at the London-based consulting firm Azure Strategy.

"Although Algeria cannot replace Gulf supplies , its pipeline gas reaches southern Europe without passing through Gulf shipping lanes, offering European governments supply diversification at a time of renewed concern about energy security," she said.

This view is echoed by Hafed Al-Ghwell, director of the North Africa, Mediterranean and the Sahel program at the Washington-based think tank Stimson Center. Al-Ghwell told DW he recently met with Algeria's foreign minister and members of the cabinet.

"You can sense very clearly that there is the political will at the highest level of government that Algeria needs to take advantage of what is happening globally as well as its unique position as a major gas producer," he said.

Algeria's value for Europe extends well beyond gas, Gower pointed out. "Algiers offers cooperation on counterterrorism, migration and Mediterranean stability," she told DW.

For years, Algeria has cooperated  with European countries on ...
body.zh: 阿尔及利亚和德国在总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特本最近访问柏林期间同意深化能源关系。但阿尔及尔仍在努力应对国内紧张局势、西撒哈拉问题和萨赫勒地区的不稳定局势。 对于阿尔及利亚总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩来说，本周对柏林的访问是他自 2019 年当选总统以来首次对德国进行正式访问。与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨的联合声明强调了为期两天的访问，两位领导人在声明中强调了两国之间的“合作质量”，并承诺深化长期能源合作。 “阿尔及利亚是欧洲能源安全的核心合作伙伴。天然气供应和可再生能源合作将得到扩大。从长远来看，这是关于建立一条南部氢走廊——从北非到德国，”德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔的发言人塞尔斯廷·加梅林周四在X上发帖称。 阿尔及利亚拥有非洲第二大天然气探明储量，仅次于尼日利亚。它也是非洲最大的天然气生产国。 7月2日，阿尔及利亚国有能源公司Sonatrach将第一批液化天然气（LNG）直接交付至德国威廉港1号浮式液化天然气进口码头。 直接通往德国的管道将消除这些体积的液化、液化天然气运输和再气化的需要。这可以降低天然气输送的运输成本，阿尔及利亚现有的两条通往意大利和西班牙的管道就是这种情况。 伦敦咨询公司Azure Strategy的地缘政治和安全总监爱丽丝·高尔(Alice Gower)表示：“伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡石油出口中断增强了阿尔及利亚的能源重要性。” 她说：“虽然阿尔及利亚无法取代海湾地区的供应，但其管道天然气无需经过海湾航道即可到达南欧，在人们重新担心能源安全之际，为欧洲各国政府提供了供应多元化。” 华盛顿智库史汀生中心北非、地中海和萨赫勒项目主任哈菲德·阿尔·格韦尔（Hafed Al-Ghwell）也赞同这一观点。 Al-Ghwell 告诉德国之声，他最近会见了阿尔及利亚外交部长和内阁成员。 他说：“你可以非常清楚地感觉到，阿尔及利亚政府最高层需要有政治意愿，以利用全球正在发生的事情及其作为主要天然气生产国的独特地位。” 高尔指出，阿尔及利亚对欧洲的价值远远超出了天然气的范围。她告诉德国之声：“阿尔及尔在反恐、移民和地中海稳定方面提供合作。” 多年来，阿尔及利亚一直与欧洲国家合作……

title.en: Spain: Emergency crews battle wildfire north of Madrid
title.zh: 西班牙：紧急救援人员在马德里北部扑灭野火

summary.en: Emergency crews in central Spain are battling a wildfire that has been raging for three days, deploying over 25 firefighting planes to contain the blaze north of Madrid.
summary.zh: 西班牙中部地区的紧急救援人员正在与一场已肆虐三天的野火搏斗，他们已部署超过25架消防飞机，以控制马德里北部的火势。

body.en:
More than 25 firefighting planes have been deployed to battle the blaze in central Spain, which has been raging for three days.

Firefighters battled to contain a fast-spreading wildfire north of Spain's   capital, Madrid , on Sunday.

The country is still reeling from one of the deadliest wildfires  in modern times that killed 13 people and destroyed 7,000 hectares in southern Almeria province earlier this month.

The latest fire started on Thursday in central Spain's Guadalajara province, which includes the Sierra Norte Natural Park.

The area is described as a forest-covered, mountainous region that is home to endangered species, including eagles and wolves.

El Pais newspaper reported that the fire had burned through more than 13,000 hectares by Sunday.

Public broadcaster RTVE reported that the flames had advanced a further 14 kilometers (9 miles) overnight.

More than 500 firefighters and emergency personnel have been deployed to contain the blaze.

Ground crews are also being assisted by 25 firefighting aircraft, officials said.

The head of the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, Emiliano Garcia-Page, paid tribute to emergency workers in a post on X, saying they had "managed to save many lives."

A man, accused of starting the fire, was arrested on Thursday, police said, citing a tipoff from neighbors.

Spain remains on high alert for summer wildfires as a severe drought and low humidity affect much of the country at the height of the tourism season.

A major wildfire earlier this month in Almeria province, in the southern Andalucia region, left 13 people dead, including several foreign nationals.

The country remains in shock after revelations that several of the victims were found in burnt-out vehicles, having failed to flee the flames.

Another wildfire in the northeastern Zaragoza province has been burning since Wednesday, forcing the evacuation of more than a thousand residents.

The regional government warned on Friday evening that the blaze is "far from under control."

However, the head of the Aragon regional government, Jorge Azcon, said Saturday was the "first day we can breathe a sigh of relief," as the fire had been mostly contained.

Since the beginning of the year, wildfires have destroyed more than 80,000 hectares across Spain.

According to the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS), that's nearly double the area burned during the same period last year.

Scientists say human-caused climate change is making heatwaves longer, hotter and more frequent — drying out landscapes and fueling more destructive wildfires.

body.zh: 超过25架消防机已出动扑灭西班牙中部的大火，大火已经肆虐了三天。 周日，消防队员奋力遏制西班牙首都马德里北部迅速蔓延的野火。 该国仍在遭受现代最致命的野火之一的影响，本月早些时候，阿尔梅里亚省南部发生了这场野火，造成 13 人死亡，7,000 公顷土地被毁。 最近的火灾于周四在西班牙中部的瓜达拉哈拉省发生，该省包括北塞拉利昂自然公园。 该地区被描述为森林覆盖的山区，是鹰和狼等濒危物种的家园。 据《国家报》报道，截至周日，大火已烧毁面积超过 13,000 公顷。 公共广播公司 RTVE 报道称，火焰在一夜之间又蔓延了 14 公里（9 英里）。 已部署 500 多名消防员和急救人员来控制火势。 官员称，地勤人员也得到了 25 架消防飞机的协助。 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区政府负责人埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇在 X 上的一篇帖子中向紧急救援人员致敬，称他们“成功拯救了许多生命”。 警方援引邻居举报称，周四逮捕了一名被指控纵火的男子。 西班牙仍对夏季野火保持高度警惕，因为在旅游旺季，严重干旱和低湿度影响了该国大部分地区。 本月早些时候，安达卢西亚南部地区阿尔梅里亚省发生了一场重大山火，造成 13 人死亡，其中包括几名外国人。 数名遇难者被发现在烧毁的车辆中，但未能逃离火焰，该国仍处于震惊之中。 自周三以来，萨拉戈萨省东北部的另一场野火一直在燃烧，迫使一千多名居民撤离。 当地政府周五晚上警告称，火势“远未得到控制”。 然而，阿拉贡地区政府负责人豪尔赫·阿兹康表示，周六是“我们可以松一口气的第一天”，因为火势已基本得到控制。 自今年年初以来，山火已摧毁西班牙全国8万多公顷土地。 根据欧洲森林火灾信息系统（EFFIS）的数据，这几乎是去年同期燃烧面积的两倍。 科学家表示，人为造成的气候变化正在使热浪变得更长、更热、更频繁，导致地表干燥，并助长更具破坏性的野火。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花一点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选新闻来源...

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

title.en: Fact check: Spotting AI-generated 'historical' images
title.zh: 事实核查：识别AI生成的“历史”图像

summary.en: DW Fact check selected three "historical" videos that aren't real — they're AI. Could you recognize the fake? Here's how to spot it — and why it matters.
summary.zh: 德国之声事实核查栏目挑选了三个并非真实的“历史”视频——它们是由人工智能生成的。你能认出这些假视频吗？本文将介绍如何识别它们以及这为何重要。

body.zh: 德国之声事实调查选择了三个不真实的“历史”视频——它们是人工智能。你能认出假货吗？以下是如何发现它以及它为何如此重要。 在意大利庞贝古城，考古学家首次利用人工智能重建了公元 79 年火山喷发受害者的图像。 随着人工智能技术的广泛应用，人工智能越来越多地被用来生成“历史”图像，而且大多不需要专家的咨询。 苏黎世大学媒体学者罗兰·迈耶 (Roland Meyer) 认为这一趋势并非巧合。 他说：“通过人工智能，似乎可以重新组合过去的图像，生成不存在但可能存在的合成图像，从而填补档案和历史记录中感知或实际的空白。” “然而，对我来说，这似乎是一个欺骗性的承诺。” 众所周知，人工智能生成器会犯错误并产生“幻觉”。 DW 事实核查解释了如何发现 AI 创建的“历史”视频。 许多病毒式传播的人工智能生成的“历史”视频声称展示了过去，模糊了事实与娱乐之间的界限。通常只需询问视频是否可以制作，就可以识别出他们。 “我们是在谈论视频已经存在的时代，还是在视频不存在的时代？”历史学家兼人工智能专家 Sebastian Kubon 问道。 这段据称描绘庞贝古城的视频仅凭这一点就可以被怀疑。 它还显示出人工智能生成的明显迹象。人们的动作就像僵尸一样，而女人的外表看起来比我们所知道的古罗马要现代得多。 人工智能工具的兴起使得创建此类“历史”图像和视频变得比以往任何时候都容易，但专家警告说，人工智能是根据现有数据进行训练的，并且会重复其偏见。 迈耶说：“人工智能生成的过去图像主要再现了迄今为止描绘过去的典型模式、陈词滥调和刻板印象。” “最重要的是，这些是我们期望的图像：不是了解过去的窗口，而是我们现在的镜子。” 其次，仔细研究图像本身及其来源是有帮助的。 在这段视频中，镜头滑近一群举着美国国旗的士兵，露出他们凝视远方的脸。它看起来更像是一部好莱坞电影，而不是真实的纪录片片段。 背景中的一名士兵出现了不自然的故障。水印也暴露了这一点：该视频是由生成式人工智能工具 Veo 制作的。 上述视频取材于 1945 年硫磺岛美军士兵的标志性照片。没有具体的真实视频片段......

reflection.en: In an age where technology can create convincing but false images, the ancient wisdom of Proverbs reminds us to be discerning. We are called to give careful thought to what we encounter, rather than simply believing everything we see or hear. This vigilance helps us navigate a complex information landscape with prudence.
reflection.zh: 在科技能创造出逼真却虚假的图像的时代，箴言的古老智慧提醒我们要有分辨力。我们被呼召要仔细思考所接触到的一切，而不是简单地相信我们所看到或听到的一切。这种警惕性帮助我们审慎地驾驭复杂的信息环境。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: EU ban on destroying unsold clothes takes effect
title.zh: 欧盟禁止销毁未售衣物生效

summary.en: New regulations in the European Union now prohibit large companies from discarding unsold clothing, accessories, and footwear as part of efforts to reduce waste.
summary.zh: 根据新规定，欧盟范围内的大公司不得再丢弃未售出的衣物、配饰和鞋类，以减少浪费。

body.en:
Under new rules to reduce waste, large companies across the European Union can no longer dispose of unsold clothes, accessories and footwear.

A ban on the disposal of unsold clothes and shoes took effect across the European Union on Sunday, in the bloc's latest move to cut waste.

Hundreds of thousands of tons of fashionwear are destroyed every year across the 27-member EU due to damage, old stock and returned online orders.

The new rule is expected to affect large fashion retailers, wholesalers and manufacturers of apparel — only 20% of which are produced in the EU.

Under the EU's Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation, large companies with more than 250 employees and over €50 million in net annual turnover are banned from destroying stocks of unsold clothing, accessories and footwear.

Firms must now find ways of selling the products, including via discounts, alternative markets and charity donations.

Unsold clothes can only be destroyed when items are unsafe, damaged, counterfeit or rejected by charities, according to a post on the European Commission's website.

Companies are now required to publish annual reports on the goods they have discarded and keep records for five years.

The regulation, which was approved by Brussels more than two years ago, will be extended to medium-sized firms in 2030.

Concerns about so-called fast fashion — low-cost, lower-quality mass-produced clothing — have grown significantly over the past decade.

According to the European Environment Agency (EEA), around 4% to 9% of unsold textile products are destroyed each year.

Across the EU, one in five fashion goods ordered online is later returned to the retailer and not resold.

Combined, this amounts to hundreds of thousands of tons of clothes, accessories and footwear.

The new ban aims to help reduce the impact on the environment , as the incineration of millions of clothes hits efforts to cut greenhouse gas emissions.

EU states are also under pressure to consider waste from raw materials, water, energy and transport in the apparel sector and to encourage more recycling and the reuse of products.

In a recent LinkedIn post, the EEA said the bloc wanted the textile industry to become more sustainable.

"A circular economy — where products are designed to last, and are reused, repaired and recycled — is no longer just a vision, but is being embedded in law through these new legislative measures," the EEA wrote.

The fashion industry has repeatedly defended its tactics, noting that disposal is often cheaper than storing, repairing or discounting the products.

The German Retail Federation (HDE) said consumers would benefit from the ban as more...
body.zh: 根据减少浪费的新规定，欧盟各地的大公司不能再处理未售出的衣服、配饰和鞋类。 周日，欧盟范围内禁止处理未售出的衣服和鞋子的禁令生效，这是欧盟减少浪费的最新举措。 在欧盟 27 个成员国中，每年有数十万吨时装因损坏、旧库存和网上订单退货而被销毁。 新规定预计将影响大型时装零售商、批发商和服装制造商——其中只有 20% 是在欧盟生产的。 根据欧盟可持续产品生态设计法规，员工超过 250 名、年净营业额超过 5000 万欧元的大公司被禁止销毁未售出的服装、配饰和鞋类库存。 企业现在必须找到销售产品的方式，包括通过折扣、替代市场和慈善捐赠。 根据欧盟委员会网站上的一篇文章，只有当物品不安全、损坏、伪造或被慈善机构拒绝时，未售出的衣服才会被销毁。 现在，公司必须公布其丢弃的货物的年度报告，并保存记录五年。 该法规于两年多前获得布鲁塞尔批准，将于 2030 年扩展到中型企业。 过去十年，人们对所谓的快时尚（低成本、低质量的批量生产服装）的担忧显着增长。 根据欧洲环境署 (EEA) 的数据，每年约有 4% 至 9% 的未售出纺织品被销毁。 在整个欧盟，网上订购的时尚商品有五分之一随后被退回零售商而不是转售。 加起来，这相当于数十万吨的衣服、配饰和鞋类。 新禁令旨在帮助减少对环境的影响，因为焚烧数百万件衣服会影响减少温室气体排放的努力。 欧盟国家还面临压力，需要考虑服装行业中原材料、水、能源和运输产生的废物，并鼓励更多的产品回收和再利用。 在最近的 LinkedIn 帖子中，欧洲经济区表示，该集团希望纺织业变得更加可持续。 欧洲经济区写道：“循环经济——产品的设计经久耐用，并可重复使用、修理和回收——不再只是一个愿景，而是通过这些新的立法措施被纳入法律。” 时尚界一再为其策略辩护，指出处理产品通常比储存、修理或打折产品便宜。 德国零售联合会（HDE）表示，随着更多……消费者将从禁令中受益。

reflection.en: This new regulation reminds us of our ancient calling to be good stewards of creation. By preventing the destruction of usable goods, societies can better honor the resources and labor invested, reflecting a deeper care for the world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 这项新规定提醒我们，人类负有管理受造物的古老使命。通过禁止销毁可用商品，社会能够更好地尊重所投入的资源和劳动力，这反映了对雅伟托付给我们的世界的更深层关怀。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Food delivery rider wins China's top literary prize
title.zh: 外卖骑手荣获中国最高文学奖

summary.en: Wang Jibing, a food delivery rider, has been awarded China's most prestigious literary prize. His achievement highlights a growing trend of blue-collar workers in China gaining recognition for their literary contributions.
summary.zh: 外卖骑手王计兵荣获中国最高文学奖。他的成就凸显了中国蓝领工人因其文学作品而获得更广泛关注的趋势。

body.en:
A collection of poems, some scribbled on slips of paper between food deliveries, has won Wang Jibing one of China's top literary honours.

Low Flight, inspired by the everyday challenges delivery riders face, has bagged the Lu Xun Literary Prize - named after a writer who has been referred to as the father of modern Chinese literature.

Wang, 56, who became a delivery rider around 2019, gained traction on social media for his poems and essays.

He is part of a growing group of blue-collar workers who are being celebrated for their literary works, which offer a glimpse into the pressures that they face in China's massive gig economy.

For Wang, the prestigious literary prize comes after a few difficult decades as an odd job worker.

"I held my breath and felt extremely nervous… Once it was revealed, everything was settled," Wang told state media outlet Global Times on 15 July, when news broke that he had won the award - adding that the media attention around him had created a lot of mental pressure on him.

The monetary awards for recipients of the Lu Xun Literary Prize are not publicly announced - though as of 2014 it stood at 100,000 Chinese yuan ($14,800; £11,000).

Born in Jiangsu province, Wang left school as a teenager due to financial hardship at home. He took on various jobs, from construction to scavenging for waste and selling things at a street stall, before becoming a food deliveryman.

But his love for reading persisted, and over the last decade he has been posting his own poems and essays on social media.

In 2022, one of his poems, titled Man in a Hurry, went viral online. It was inspired by a incident in 2019, in which he spent hours on a frustrating delivery after a customer entered the wrong address.

In 2023 he published his first poetry collection, Man in a Hurry: Poems of a Food Delivery Rider.

Despite winning the award, Wang told the outlet he had no intention of quitting his job, adding that he planned to work until he turns 60.

"Financially I don't need this job to make a living, but I love the vibe of the work and it keeps me fit," said the Global Times report. "I want a down-to-earth life and the award will never change who I am."

Low Flight, published in 2024, is a collection of poems inspired by interviews and surveys that Wang conducted with around 200 delivery riders.

"Who says spreading your wings means flying high? Flying low is also flying," goes one of the lines in his poems.

His win comes as a growing number of blue worker collars in China have in recent years been making their mark in the literary world.

I Deliver Parcels in Beijing, a 2023 memoir by former courier Hu Anyan, became a runaway bestseller in China and also captured media attention abroad. An English translation of the memoir was published last...
body.zh: 王吉兵的一本诗集（其中一些是在送餐期间写在纸条上的）为他赢得了中国最高文学荣誉之一。 《低空飞行》的灵感来自于外卖骑手每天面临的挑战，它获得了鲁迅文学奖——以一位被称为中国现代文学之父的作家的名字命名。 王现年 56 岁，2019 年左右成为一名送货骑手，他的诗歌和散文在社交媒体上受到关注。 他是越来越多的蓝领工人群体中的一员，这些工人因其文学作品而受到赞誉，这让人们得以一窥他们在中国庞大的零工经济中面临的压力。 对于王来说，享有盛誉的文学奖是在他作为打零工经历了几十年艰难的生活之后获得的。 7月15日，当他获奖的消息传出时，王告诉官方媒体《环球时报》：“我屏住呼吸，感到非常紧张……一旦揭晓，一切就都解决了。”他还补充说，周围媒体的关注给他带来了很大的精神压力。 鲁迅文学奖获奖者的奖金并未公开公布，但截至 2014 年，奖金为 10 万元人民币（14,800 美元；11,000 英镑）。 王出生于江苏省，青少年时期因家庭经济困难而辍学。在成为一名送餐员之前，他从事过各种工作，从建筑到清理垃圾，再到在街边摊上卖东西。 但他对阅读的热爱始终如一，在过去的十年里，他一直在社交媒体上发布自己的诗歌和散文。 2022年，他的一首诗《匆忙的男人》在网上疯传。它的灵感来自 2019 年的一次事件，当时一位顾客输入了错误的地址，他花了几个小时处理令人沮丧的送货事宜。 2023年，他出版了第一部诗集《匆忙的人：送餐骑手的诗》。 尽管获奖，王告诉媒体他无意辞职，并补充说他计划工作到 60 岁。 《环球时报》报道称：“从经济上来说，我不需要这份工作来谋生，但我喜欢这份工作的氛围，它让我保持健康。” “我想要脚踏实地的生活，这个奖项永远不会改变我是谁。” 《低空飞行》于 2024 年出版，是一本诗集，灵感来自于王对约 200 名送货骑手进行的采访和调查。 “谁说展翅高飞？低飞也是飞翔。”他的诗中有这样一句话。 他的获奖之际，近年来，越来越多的中国蓝领工人在文学界崭露头角。 前快递员胡安彦于 2023 年出版的回忆录《我在北京送包裹》在中国成为畅销书，也引起了海外媒体的关注。该回忆录的英文译本于去年出版......

reflection.en: This story reminds us that every form of honest labor holds dignity, and talent can emerge from any walk of life. Yahweh calls us to approach all our work, no matter how humble, with diligence and excellence, as if serving Him directly. Such dedication often reveals hidden gifts and brings unexpected honor.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，每一种诚实的劳动都具有尊严，才能可以从各行各业中涌现。雅伟呼召我们以勤勉和卓越的态度对待我们所有的工作，无论多么卑微，如同直接服事他一样。这种奉献常常会显露隐藏的恩赐，并带来意想不到的荣耀。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

body.en: Startling new research shows that in many countries – including old US allies – the public prefers Beijing to Washington Earlier this year, a spate of western TikTok and Instagram creators announced that they were at “a very Chinese time in my life” – drinking hot water and wearing slippers around their homes. The Chinamaxxing phenomenon primarily reflected the constant need of influencers for novel content. But social media trends also reflect a growing fascination with China, as the economic historian Adam Tooze has noted . While it broods over China’s economic, military and technical advance, the Trump administration is accelerating Beijing’s diplomatic progress, as striking new polling by the Pew Research Center shows. For the first time, China and Xi Jinping are seen more favourably than the US and its president in most of the 36 major countries surveyed – including Canada, Mexico and Australia. Only in six countries did people rate the US more highly. While Beijing has seen significant improvements in some places, the slump in Washington’s standing is more dramatic. Across 20 countries, the median percentage with a favourable view of China rose from 32% to 46% between 2023 and this year; for the US, it fell from 58% to 36%. Views of China were much more positive in Latin America, Africa and parts of south and south-east Asia than in wealthier European and east Asian countries. Continue reading...
body.zh: 令人震惊的新研究表明，在许多国家 — — 包括美国的老盟友 — — 公众更喜欢北京而不是华盛顿。 今年早些时候，一大批西方 TikTok 和 Instagram 创作者宣布，他们正处于“我一生中非常中国化的时期”——喝着热水，在家中穿着拖鞋。 Chinamaxshing现象主要反映了网红对新颖内容的持续需求。但正如经济历史学家亚当·图兹（Adam Tooze）指出的那样，社交媒体趋势也反映出人们对中国日益增长的迷恋。皮尤研究中心令人震惊的最新民意调查显示，在关注中国经济、军事和技术进步的同时，特朗普政府正在加速北京的外交进展。在接受调查的 36 个主要国家（包括加拿大、墨西哥和澳大利亚）中，大多数国家对中国和习近平的好感度首次高于美国及其总统。只有六个国家的人们对美国的评价更高。尽管北京在某些方面取得了显着进步，但华盛顿的地位下滑更为严重。 2023 年至今，20 个国家对中国持好感的中位数百分比从 32% 上升至 46%；美国则从 58% 下降至 36%。拉丁美洲、非洲以及南亚和东南亚部分地区对中国的看法比富裕的欧洲和东亚国家要积极得多。继续阅读...

title.en: China firm seeks damages over state control of British Steel
title.zh: 中国公司就英国钢铁国有化寻求赔偿

summary.en: China's Jingye Group is seeking compensation from the UK government after the government took over British Steel last year. The UK government intervened to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility, which Jingye Group had purchased in 2020.
summary.zh: 中国敬业集团正向英国政府寻求赔偿，此前英国政府去年接管了英国钢铁公司，以防止该国最后一个主要炼钢设施关闭。敬业集团于2020年收购了该公司。

body.en:
The UK government took over British Steel last year to prevent the closure of the country's last primary steelmaking facility. China's Jingye Group, which bought the firm in 2020, claims it is owed compensation.

A Chinese steel giant demanded compensation from the United Kingdom   government on Sunday, claiming the state's takeover of its subsidiary, British Steel, was "outright robbery."

The UK government took operational control of British Steel last year, after owner Jingye Group warned that Britain's last factory capable of making steel from scratch was no longer financially viable.

In a statement on social media, Jingye threatened legal action against the UK government, accusing ministers of "trampling on international investment rules."

Describing the nationalization as "outright robbery," the Chinese firm said it "reserves all legal rights, firmly defends its lawful rights and interests, and will pursue full compensation through legal means to the very end."

"The UK disregarded Jingye's continuous investment and significant contribution and was only willing to provide almost zero compensation,” the statement continued.

The company noted that nationalization could cost UK taxpayers more than 1.5 billion pounds ($2.02 billion, €1.76 billion) by 2028.

Jingye said it had begun a procedure under bilateral investment agreements to seek damages, without expanding further.

China's Foreign Ministry backed the compensation move, calling on the UK to "earnestly respect market principles and the spirit of contract, and find solutions on compensation and other issues acceptable to both sides."

After Jingye last year planned to close the blast furnaces at its plant in Scunthorpe, in northern England, the UK government passed emergency measures, allowing it to take  operational control of British Steel .

The immediate concern was that the blast furnaces would be shut permanently, ending the UK's capacity to produce virgin or primary steel from raw materials. The plant accounts for the vast majority of British Steel's operations.

The government cited national security for the move, which came five years after Jingye bought British Steel from a London-based private equity firm for around 70 million pounds.

Ministers cited the need to protect strategic steel supplies for construction, rail infrastructure and defense.

The move was also seen as a way to protect thousands of jobs in a deprived area of the UK. The Scunthorpe plant currently employs about 2,700 people.

In recent weeks, the UK Parliament has passed legislation that allowed the government on Thursday to bring British Steel into full public ownership.

reflection.en: When governments intervene in economic affairs, the call for justice and righteousness remains paramount. Yahweh's word reminds leaders to act fairly, ensuring that all parties, including investors, are treated equitably and not unjustly deprived. This principle encourages thoughtful consideration of compensation and fair dealings in complex situations...
reflection.zh: 当政府干预经济事务时，对公义和正直的呼吁至关重要。雅伟的话语提醒领导者要公正行事，确保包括投资者在内的所有各方都受到公平对待，不被不公正地剥夺。这一原则鼓励在涉及国家利益和私营企业的复杂情况下，深思熟虑赔偿和公平交易。

title.en: Trump, not Iran, is the world’s greatest danger. He’s a one-man weapon of mass destruction | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 特朗普，而非伊朗，是世界上最大的危险。他是一个人的大规模杀伤性武器 | 西蒙·蒂斯代尔

summary.en: The article argues that the US president's actions have initiated a disastrous war and an economic quagmire, leading to a "limitless fiasco" as bombing resumes. It characterizes the president as "feckless and clueless," unable to navigate or exit the conflict he started.
summary.zh: 文章指出，随着轰炸再次开始，美国总统的行为已将美国拖入一场无止境的灾难和经济泥潭。文章形容这位总统“无能又糊涂”，无法摆脱他所发动的这场灾难性战争。

body.en: As the bombing starts again, it’s clear the president has dragged the US into a limitless fiasco – and the world into an economic quagmire Feckless and clueless, Donald Trump is lost in Iran, unable to find a way out of the disastrous war he started. Once again, the US military is pummelling the country and, increasingly, its civilian infrastructure. As before, this unlawful bludgeoning strengthens the resistance of a hardline regime that cares little for its people’s suffering. How often have Trump and Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon’s wildling lord of bones, hailed a bogus victory? The president claimed this week to be “winning big”. No one believes him. Even as it counts the vast human and economic cost of his Persian folly, a watching world scoffs at US impotence. Control of the strait of Hormuz, closed due to Trump’s belligerence, is now the White House’s limited, elusive objective. The grander US and Israeli war aims – eliminating Iran’s nuclear programme, degrading its regional militias, regime change – are less attainable than ever. It’s Trump’s craven leadership that renders US forces ineffective, not the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. If Iran really is the existential menace he claims, the logical course would be all-out conquest. When George W Bush decided Iraq posed unacceptable dangers, he invaded with 170,000 ground troops. body.en:
In a speech attacking US election integrity on Friday, US President Donald Trump released intelligence that he said showed major Chinese interference in US elections, reviving his false claims he won the 2020 election.

Trump's allegations about the "shocking vulnerabilities" in the American electoral system appeared to lay the groundwork for the Republican to dispute the results of November's crucial US midterm elections .

It underscored Trump's effort to make election security a central political issue ahead of November's midterm vote, when Republicans in Congress will face the prospect of losing control of both the House of Representatives and Senate — an outcome that would carry significant political consequences for Trump.

"We can never watch a stolen election again," Trump said in the primetime address, referencing his 2020 presidential election defeat by Democrat Joe Biden.

Trump said he was declassifying huge amounts of intelligence data that showed, among other things, that superpower rival China had illicitly acquired 220 million US voter files.

"Over a period of years, starting during the 2020 election cycle, the People's Republic of China carried out what is believed to be the largest compromise of election data in history," Trump said in the televised speech from the White House.

He asserted that members of the US intelligence community deliberately suppressed information about the extent of China's activities.

His allegations contradict an unclassified 2021 US intelligence community assessment that found no indications any foreign actor tried to alter or succeeded in altering "any technical aspect" of the 2020 presidential election vote.

The assessment was conducted under John Ratcliffe, then Trump's director of national intelligence and now his CIA director.

Trump also claimed there were more than 250,000 non-US citizens registered to vote in four states.

Trump has persistently claimed his 2020 election defeat was "rigged," although more than 60 lawsuits produced no ruling establishing fraud capable of changing the outcome, while recounts, audits and his own justice department found none.

After railing against election security in the 25-minute address, Trump pressed Republicans in Congress to pass his signature elections legislation, the SAVE America Act, which has been stalled for months.

It seeks to impose new voter identification and citizenship requirements, despite longstanding findings that voter fraud in US elections is rare.

Election security experts have said these measures would make it harder for millions of eligible voters to cast a ballot.

title.en: Israel's embassy takes rare swipe at Labor's platform on eve of conference

body.en:
Israel's embassy has rebuked the Labor party's draft national platform, warning its wording on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict places sole "responsibility" on the Jewish state while overlooking the role of Hamas and Palestinian leadership.

The four-page statement is a highly unusual intervention by a foreign government ahead of the party's national conference in Adelaide.

Labor's 2026 platform, which outlines the party's priorities and beliefs, contains an expanded statement on "Israel and Palestine" following the government's move to recognise Palestinian statehood, a longstanding part of the party platform.

The document reiterates support for a two-state solution, and also says the party "unreservedly condemns terrorism and violent extremism, including as perpetrated by Hamas and other extremists," stating Israelis and Palestinians deserve to live their lives free from terror and violence.

The platform says Israel "must comply with obligations as an occupying power" in supplying food and medical supplies for Palestinian civilians under international humanitarian law, and also condemns recent Knesset laws around the death penalty as "discriminatory."

The 'Death Penalty for Terrorists' law passed in March — and a subsequent 2026 military tribunal law — mandate capital punishment for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The United Nations Human Rights Office warned the laws breach international humanitarian law and could amount to war crimes.

The unsigned Israeli embassy statement, released on Monday, reads: "The Embassy respectfully submits that several elements of the draft National Platform risk placing responsibility for the conflict on one party while giving insufficient attention to the decisions, conduct and continuing obligations of the Palestinian leadership and terrorist organisations such as Hamas."

"Israel has repeatedly demonstrated its willingness to make difficult compromises when genuine peace is possible."

While continuing to oppose Palestinian recognition, which the Australian government declared sovereign and independent in September 2025, Israel's embassy also disputed language in the draft platform condemning "extremist settler violence," which the government in June warned was at "horrific levels".

The embassy said settler violence "receives disproportionate attention," labelling it a "reprehensible but marginal phenomenon".

On Sunday, social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami in the United States, after authorities in the United Kingdom issued 38 new charges against the brothers, deepening the pair's international legal saga and adding further complication to an already fraught legal situation.

The United Kingdom's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) has charged the brothers — who deny all wrongdoing — with fresh counts of rape, actual bodily harm, and human trafficking.

The new accusations add to a mountain of serious charges against the pair and could lead to the brothers' extradition from the US, assuming it is approved by the US state department.

Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan Tate are dual US-UK citizens who have risen to prominence as social media influencers.

Andrew started his career in public life as a kickboxer and has gone on to become a prominent figure in the online 'manosphere' space, describing himself as a misogynist and encouraging his more than 10 million followers to follow in his footsteps.

He primarily posts on X, having been banned from YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram for violating hate speech guidelines.

Stephanie Wescott, a lecturer in humanities and social science at Monash University, described Andrew as the "main character" of this content, while his brother Tristan is more of a "side figure".

She said the Tates have turned disrespecting and abusing women into a business model that glamorises male dominance, 'teaching' men how to emulate them through an online academy.

"[They promote] anti-feminism, anti-gender-equality, and hyper-masculinity or, you know, 'men being men' or men going back to a type of manhood that no longer exists," she said.

"One of their business models has been to train other young men into becoming the sort of influencers that they claim that they are.

"Part of that business model has also been to exploit and harm the girls and women around you and to use their images as currency to sell online — we know Australian men have signed up for these services.

The pair have also expressed support for US President Donald Trump, and Trump's eldest son, Donald Trump Jr, spoke out against the brothers' detention in Romania in 2023.

"The other layer to this is, of course, that they have this incredible political proximity to Donald Trump," Wescott said.

In 2025, Andrew Tate said he was "very close with the Trump family". Trump himself has said little about the Tates, however.

"They have been supported and aided by adjacent figures, podcasters such as Joe Rogan and others like him," Wescott continued.

title.en: Nigel Farage's unusual UK by-election now has an Australian candidate

summary.en: Nigel Farage will compete in the Clacton by-election against several candidates, including Count Binface and Australian Daniel Pocock.

body.en:
There's a man with a bin on his head, three people representing the Monster Raving Loony Party, Nigel Farage and an Australian — now all vying for the seat vacated by the Reform UK leader in a crucial by-election.

The Clacton by-election, triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Farage over a donations scandal, has attracted all sorts of profiles to the mix.

Farage, who is under investigation over millions of pounds' worth of undeclared gifts and donations from wealthy backers, quit parliament earlier this month to trigger a by-election, but said he would re-contest his seat . The Reform UK leader said he wanted voters in his electoral district in south-east England to judge his actions, not what he said was a liberal "establishment" bent on discrediting him.

Farage is widely expected to win the seat again, and is the only mainstream candidate running, after other major parties said they would refuse to take part in what they characterised as a stunt.

A number of joke candidates — including Count Binface and another called 'Nick the Incredible Flying Brick' — are vying for the seat, along with 20 independents.

Pocock is a Swiss-Irish-Australian software engineer who describes himself as an "expert on cybersecurity, open source software [and] cryptocurrencies".

According to his website, he was born in the Melbourne suburb of Coburg before moving to rural Wandong. He graduated from the University of Melbourne in 2002 with a Bachelor of Computer Science.

While studying, he joined the National Union of Students and used his technical skills to assist websites for early social causes. He built a website opposing the death penalty after Schapelle Corby's arrest in Bali on drug trafficking charges.

He moved to Europe after graduation and worked for companies like Barclays Capital, Thomson Reuters, and UBS.

In a press release announcing his candidacy, Pocock says he was spurred to nominate himself for Clacton by the prospect of "novelty candidates".

"If the Essex Lion was to appear on the ballot paper, I suspect it would have an equally good chance of winning. I have yet to see a single report about the real, day-to-day issues facing residents of the district," he said.

"In a parody of this situation, I have chosen the codename Pocock-on-Sea for the operation to unleash an Australian upon London's Establishment."

Pocock said Farage has proposed many Australian policies to replace UK ones, though he did not specify which. Farage has previously outlined an immigration plan that echoes Australia's offshore processing system, which has been heavily criticised by human rights...

body.en:
Derryn Hinch has been remembered for making waves as one of Australia's most outspoken and influential voices.

Longtime friend and colleague Darren James led mourners through a state funeral for the former broadcaster and senator on Monday.

"He was a journalist, a newspaper reporter, a TV presenter, a godfather, an author, a senator and, a prisoner ... he did it all," James told the service.

Hinch died on 10 July at the age of 82 after a lengthy health struggle , much of which he documented for followers on social media.

The service for the lifelong atheist, who went to jail for identifying a paedophile Catholic priest before his trial, was held at the Timber Yard events space in Port Melbourne, near factories and apartments devoid of any religious leaning.

It attracted notable figures, including news presenters Ray Martin and Denis Walter, entertainers Rhonda Burchmore and Greg Evans, and former Crown executive Ann Peacock.

Other mourners, including Labor MP Danny Pearson, who attended on behalf of Premier Jacinta Allan, streamed in to pay their respects.

"Not all of us knew him personally, but for many it felt like we did," Pearson said.

An Australian flag was draped over his casket, surrounded by vases of red roses symbolising deep love, respect, courage and enduring affection.

Hinch initially moved from New Zealand to Australia to pursue a career in journalism, climbing the ranks to become editor of The Sun before turning to a career in radio.

He became known as the "human headline" — a moniker he enthusiastically adopted — for his outspoken and often controversial opinions.

Former 3AW colleagues Denis O'Kane and Tony Tardio spoke of their love for Hinch, who was well known for his hatred of child sex offenders and those who shielded them.

"He was a journalistic James Bond, drama followed him everywhere — even to his first wedding. And then he went on to marry three other times."

His ex-wife and friend, actor Jacki Weaver, sent a video tribute from America describing Hinch as a wonderful stepfather and companion.

"I'd like to pay my respects to all the women who loved Derryn, and who loved him back," she said.

While commanding the airwaves for decades as a talkback radio host on Melbourne radio station 3AW, Hinch became known for his uninhibited takes and a tendency to court controversy.

Later, Hinch turned to the political arena, forming Derryn Hinch's Justice Party and serving as a senator for Victoria in the federal parliament from 2016 to 2019.

title.en: 'Impossible': Nauru community detainees say Australian funds not enough to buy food with
title.zh: “不可能”：瑙鲁社区被拘留者称澳大利亚资金不足以购买食物

summary.en: They face a choice between paying for food, water or internet.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Asylum seekers being detained within the community in Nauru are struggling to buy enough food and are being forced to choose between eating and paying for other necessities.

The difficulties are being driven by a mix of high living costs and low income support, according to a new report by the Asylum Seeker Resource Centre.

Of 78 people interviewed for the report, 99 per cent said they couldn't afford to buy enough food with their current allowance.

On top of that, 68 per cent said they rarely or never had access to fresh fruit, vegetables and meat, and 82 per cent said they didn't have easy access to free, clean drinking water.

Community detainees live on $260 a fortnight to cover all of their basic needs outside accommodation.

The group have been sent to the tiny island nation under Australia's long-standing policy of offshore processing for asylum-seekers who arrive by boat.

Speaking anonymously, detainees consistently told the centre the allowance wasn't enough to sustain them, forcing them to decide between buying food and other necessities like clothing and internet access.

Many were running out of money before their next payment and were forced to reduce meals or go without food altogether.

"With food we have to compromise, if you buy vegetables you can't afford rice. If you buy meat, you can't afford fruit," one said.

"The money is not enough because everything is expensive here — rice, fish, we cannot buy any fruit here, internet for $100 per month, how is it possible to survive?" said another.

Nauru struggles with food insecurity due to its remote location and limited local agriculture, with perishable food flown in weekly and often selling out quickly or being prohibitively expensive.

With no rivers or freshwater lakes, the island also relies primarily on rainwater harvesting and desalination, meaning water shortages are common during times of low rainfall, forcing those who live there to turn to bottled water.

Asylum seekers in the community often struggle due to their lack of orientation or local knowledge as to how food systems work, as well as infrequent transportation to and from markets, the resource centre said.

As of 31 May, there were 101 people seeking asylum in Nauru, 91 of whom were in community accommodation.

The majority of those in detention in Nauru were young to middle-aged men from south and east Asia.

The group of asylum seekers are separate from a group of hundreds of former immigration detainees, known as the NZYQ cohort, sent to Nauru from Australia after the High Court in 2024 ruled indefinite detention to be unlawful.

body.en:
Vincent Simmons has never left the United States before. But in a few days, he'll board a 15-hour flight to Melbourne. Not for the beaches, the coffee or the art — but for a cinema.

Splitting the cost across a few credit cards, the 35-year-old Los Angeles projectionist has put close to $4,000 into flights and accommodation for the three-week trip, all to watch The Odyssey — the latest film from Oscar-winning director Christopher Nolan, released in Australia on 16 July — at Melbourne's IMAX.

He'll see it there twice — on top of a screening back home in LA just before he flies out.

"I've heard about the IMAX in Melbourne for years — I've probably watched every YouTube video that shows even a sliver of it," Simmons tells SBS News. "I told myself I'd go one day."

"70mm IMAX offers hands down the greatest sensory engrossment you could possibly have when watching a film," he explains.

"It's the closest sense of lifelike fidelity — a transcendent film format that everyone should experience at least once in their life. But to be fair, if they experience it once, they will want to experience it again."

"I was brave enough to undertake my own odyssey in travelling to Melbourne," he says.

It's one of only 41 in the world equipped to project true IMAX 70mm film, the largest film stock in existence — so large that the camera has to be reloaded every three minutes during a shoot.

At 32 metres wide and 23 metres tall, and with an aspect ratio of 1.43:1, the Melbourne IMAX's screen is also the biggest of its kind anywhere.

"Because we're only one of 41 cinemas in the entire world that can screen this film on IMAX 70mm on our large 1.43:1 aspect ratio screen, it's a place that customers seek out," Jeremy Fee, general manager at IMAX Melbourne, tells SBS News.

"This is the only place in Australia, in the southern hemisphere, that you can see it in the way that Christopher Nolan intended."

Its reels run on platters so large they can hold three hours of runtime — just eight minutes more than The Odyssey's own two hours and 52 minutes.

Each session requires constant quality assurance checks to keep the film running true — and just five people in Australia are currently qualified to do it.

"It's a perishable skill," he says. "It was [a dying craft] … I think it's a growing art form now."

While a renewed appreciation for the craft may have averted — or at least delayed — its demise, the current scarcity of those accredited to carry it out is exactly what's pulling people across oceans to watch a movie in Melbourne.

body.en:
Ultra-processed foods (UPFs) comprise up to 50 per cent of our calories. And while some provide significant nutrients for a balanced diet, others could be responsible for damage in every major bodily organ. So, what are UPFs, and are they as bad as they’re made out to be?

I didn't have to read food labels consistently. I didn't have to pack a heap of snacks before leaving the house for long periods. I didn't have to ask so many questions to hospitality staff about food preparation and cross-contamination.

Things are much more complicated now whenever there is food involved — during travel, socialising, or even just going over to the homes of family and friends.

Coeliac disease is a chronic autoimmune disease triggered by eating gluten. When someone with coeliac disease eats gluten, their immune system mistakes it for a threat and attacks their own body in response, causing damage over time.

My symptoms started in early 2020 when I was 31 and caught a gastro bug, which I believe acted as a trigger for my genetic susceptibility to the disease.

I started developing extreme pain after eating certain foods. Then I experienced rapid weight loss, losing around 10kg in under 12 months without changing my diet or my exercise routines.

I had other debilitating symptoms too, including headaches, migraines, stomach cramps, mouth ulcers, brain fog, constipation, diarrhoea, joint inflammation, back pain, anxiety and depression — the list goes on.

I was sent for every possible test: a stool sample, ultrasound, MRI, CT and full blood work — almost all returning normal results.

With all the test results returning as normal, my wife and I considered the possibility that all these symptoms might be in my head.

Eventually, a friend suggested I undergo a test for coeliac disease, as she'd had similar symptoms and been diagnosed with it the year prior.

I got the test, and my results were off the chart. I then had a biopsy via endoscopy to confirm the diagnosis.

It's been a serious learning process; not worrying about what I put into my body for three decades and then suddenly having an extreme dietary restriction is a massive adjustment.

One consequence of always checking the ingredients on labels for gluten is that you quickly learn what's in processed and ultra-processed foods.

Ultra-processed foods are rife in the gluten-free category, and there are often a lot of processed additives to make gluten-free alternatives sweeter and give them a more appealing texture and sensation when eaten.
